annotations.title: Road cameras and camera checks near a point

description: Road cameras within a radius of a latitude and longitude (default 1 mile, max 5), nearest first, each with a link to its current still and whether it has live video; plus the camera checks CitySignal ran on alerts there in the last N hours (default 24, max 72): what the camera showed and whether it matched the alert. CitySignal does not record video, so footage of a past moment exists only as a check's saved frame, viewable in the signed-in app. Use for 'is there a camera on this spot', 'do we have footage of this', 'what did the camera show'. It does not geocode: resolve the place to lat and lon first.
